newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolsa extends Corimon suspension.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolsa extends Corimon suspension.

text.p: Venezuela's National Shares Commission (CNV) said Monday it had extended the suspension of shares of troubled paints and packaging firm Corimon on local capital markets to Sept 30.
Corimon has been suspended from trading since Feb 13 when a report of heavy losses in the previous financial year saw the stock's price drop steeply.

Corimon recently announced a 12.22 billion bolivar net profit in the quarter ending June 30. In mid-August the company announced that it had reached an agreement with creditors representing 90 percent of its $45 million bolivar-denominated debt.
